paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how tweet (or text) sentiment polarity scores for Indonesia are distributed by showing the count of items at a sequence of polarity score values. The x-axis is labeled “Polarity scores,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from −1.1 to 0.6 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.2 intervals (−1.0, −0.8, −0.6, …, 0.6). The y-axis is labeled “Counts,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to about 35,000 with tick labels every 5,000. A single blue solid line with circular markers connects the counts across polarity scores: counts are near 0 at the most negative scores around −1.1 to about −0.7, rise to roughly 600 at about −0.6, then to about 3,500 around −0.55 and about 3,200 around −0.45 before dipping to roughly 1,800 near −0.38; the series increases again to around 4,500 near −0.3, about 9,200 near −0.2, and about 17,500 near −0.1, reaching its highest point at approximately 35,000 at a polarity score of 0.0; after this peak it drops to around 12,200 near 0.1, rises again to about 17,600 at around 0.2, then declines to about 6,300 near 0.3 and about 500 near 0.4, followed by a smaller rise to roughly 5,900 near 0.47 and a final drop to near 0 by about 0.55.
